dict.string: Brim uses Automation to ask Finder to move items to the Trash when you clean up files or uninstall apps.
Brim uses Bluetooth only to read the battery level of connected peripherals. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Brim checks local metadata in Downloads to review, organize or trash only confirmed WhatsApp files you choose. The Cleaner also looks for forgotten screenshots when you save screenshots here.
